I have one final-final adjustment to the mechanics that should make everything cleaner and easier to code, without any strange half-expiring tickets.
This new rule replaces the earlier ticket lifespan description:
→ Whenever someone mints using a referral code, the referrer immediately receives two distinct tickets on their NFT:
+1 Small Block Ticket
+1 Big Block Ticket

The two counters operate completely independently.
Small Block ($2,500 pool → 5 × $500 draw):
Only Small Block Tickets issued after the previous small block are eligible for the draw.
Once the draw is complete, burn/reset every Small Block Ticket to 0.
Big Block ($100,000 pool → 5 × $20,000 draw):
Only Big Block Tickets issued after the previous big block are eligible for the draw.
Once the draw is complete, burn/reset every Big Block Ticket to 0.

The result is:
Small blocks remain extremely fair and fresh because no old tickets carry over.
Big blocks build up naturally, allowing people to watch their big block entries increase over weeks/months.
Metadata becomes very simple: display only the two counters plus permanent badges.

The triggers remain pool-based: the small block activates as soon as the small pool = exactly $2,500, and the big block activates when the big pool = exactly $100,000. Secondary royalties continue to fund the pools but do not generate tickets.
All other mechanics remain unchanged, including the auto $5 commission, assigning a random ticket to an existing NFT when no referral is used, manual claim, etc.
This approach should be simpler both to implement and to explain to users.
Apologies for changing direction again — once you confirm that this is cleaner for you as well, we’re 100% locked.

I’ve noticed one problem. Coinbase Commerce is NOT an actual fiat/credit card processor; it is a cryptocurrency payment gateway. Users still must have crypto in order to pay!

Here is what is happening, along with some genuine alternatives:
Coinbase Commerce requires users to:
1. Already have cryptocurrency (USDC, ETH, BTC, etc.)
2. Transfer it from their wallet to finish the payment
3. Recognize that it is NOT accepting credit cards directly
Consequently, it is unsuitable for genuinely non-crypto users who do not own any cryptocurrency.

Actual Fiat On-Ramp Solutions
For TRUE Visa/Mastercard payments, you will need other services:

Option 1: Stripe + Crypto (Recommended)
Best suited to: Direct card payments + automated blockchain transactions
Pros:
- Accepts real credit card payments
- Users never need crypto
- Fees are lower than with crypto payments
- Provides a familiar checkout flow

Cons:
- Stripe account verification is required
- Costs 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction

Option 2: Coinbase Pay (Different from Commerce)
Unlike Commerce, Coinbase Pay supports:
- Payments by credit card
- OAuth authentication
- Converting fiat → crypto

Pros:
- Benefits from trust in the Coinbase brand
- Built-in fiat → crypto conversion

Cons:
- A Coinbase account is required
- The user must purchase crypto first

Option 3: Third-Party Fiat Gateways
Services providing genuine fiat → crypto include:
- MoonPay - Credit card → crypto widget
- Ramp Network - Fiat on-ramp widget
- Wyre - Fiat gateway (being sunset)
- Transak - Global fiat on-ramp

Pros:
- Supports real credit card payments
- Offers pre-built widgets
- Provides global coverage

Cons:
- Fees are higher (3-5%)
- KYC requirements apply
- The user still sees the crypto conversion

What does Project Rebuild involve?
Project Rebuild is my public mission to restore my family’s life after we lost everything because of a seed-phrase mistake.
I’m selling my novella memoir on Base as an unlimited-mint NFT ebook, powered by my first-of-its-kind FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model).
By sharing it, readers can earn instant, unlimited commissions & prizes. If the model succeeds, it will become BooksOnChain — a community-owned platform serving every indie creator.

How can buyers make money?
1. Receive an instant $5 commission whenever somebody mints with your referral code
2. Earn Small & Big Block prize tickets each time a person mints using your code
3. Receive the future BooksOnChain governance token (for buyers, affiliates, and tippers)

How does the referral system operate?
The mint number of every NFT IS its permanent referral code.
Either of these examples works perfectly:
→ Share the complete link
→ Or simply tell someone “use referral 423”
When a person mints with your code, you immediately receive $5 + Small & Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks.

How can I locate my referral code?
Your referral code is your mint number. It will appear:
- In your NFT metadata on-chain
- On your Dashboard once you have minted
- In your confirmation email (optional)

### How do Small Block and Big Block prizes work?
Small Block: 5 × $500 are drawn every ~500 sales (mint + secondary)
Big Block: 5 × $10,000 are drawn every ~50,000 sales (mint + secondary)
Every sale funds the pools forever.

### How are the winners chosen?
Winners are selected through Chainlink VRF — entirely on-chain, provably fair, and verifiable on Basescan.

### What do Small & Big Block prize tickets represent?
They are one-time entries for the current Small Block and current Big Block draws.
You receive them only when people mint through your code (1 Small + 1 Big for each successful referral).
After the block is drawn, those tickets expire, and subsequent referrals apply to the next blocks.

### How can I collect my rewards?
- $5 commissions → transferred to your wallet automatically
- Prize wins → posted on the Winners page and claimable with one click here on [URL_002]

### What do badges mean?
Badges are added to your NFT on-chain when you reach referral milestones (2, 10, 50, 100+).
At present, they are cosmetic + leaderboard flex only. Later, they may provide access to token-gated chats, discounts, airdrops, DAO weight, etc.

### Can I use fiat (credit card) to mint?
Yes — Transak accepts cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Neither crypto nor a wallet is required.

### Is a wallet required to participate?
Only when you want affiliate commissions paid to you or intend to trade the NFT later.

### Which blockchain does this use?
Base (Ethereum L2) — fast, inexpensive, and Coinbase-backed.

### Are hidden fees involved?
No. A mint costs exactly $15. Secondary sales include a clearly displayed flat $10 royalty.

### What occurs when I sell my NFT?
The purchaser receives the book, your original mint number (which becomes their referral code), and all badges you earned. Any expired prize tickets remain expired.

### How can I share my referral link/code?
From the Dashboard → copy the complete link, or copy only your mint number and tell people “use referral 423”.

### Is this a pyramid scheme or scam?
No. It is single-level only, the supply is unlimited, and the full source is verified on Basescan. I receive exactly $4 from every sale forever — the same cut from mints and every secondary sale.

Page Title: About Project Rebuild
Sub-title: The first ebook launch that pays readers to spread it.

What is Project Rebuild?
Project Rebuild serves as the live proof-of-concept for FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model) — the first system that allows indie creators to sell NFT ebooks with unlimited minting and reward readers with real commissions + prize tickets for sharing them.
It is launching on Base with my own raw memoir novella, "My Underdog Journey: To Own Goal,".
It is also my public mission to rebuild my family's life after a seed-phrase wipeout caused us to lose millions.

If our FAMM proves itself here, Project Rebuild will become BooksOnChain — a community-owned public good platform for every creator.

Built with Cutting-Edge Technology

- Smart Contracts
Secure, audited Solidity on Base.
- Chainlink VRF
Random prize-draw selection that is provably fair.
- Aave Integration
Deposits allow the prize pools to generate yield.
- Base Network
Fast transactions and low fees, supported by Ethereum security.
- Decentralized
All logic is fully on-chain from day one, while V1 includes initial safeguards.
(battle-testing will guide the evolution to full decentralization)

- Secure
Uses industry-leading protocols and best practices.

The Process

Mint the ebook NFT
Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

Earn Through Referrals
Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration.
If no code is provided → the $5 + tickets are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

Build Up Tickets
Every referral also awards you Small & Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks.
More referrals = more tickets = greater chances.

Enter the Prize Draws
Small Block: 5 × $500 awarded every 500 sales.
Big Block: 5 × $10,000 awarded every 50,000 sales.
(Sales = mint + secondary)
Chainlink VRF selects the winners randomly and fairly.

Receive Your Rewards
Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page and can be claimed with one click whenever you're ready.

Key Features

Automatic Rewards: Smart contracts issue all payments instantly.
Fair Prize Selection: Chainlink VRF provides genuine randomness.
Yield Generation: Aave Integration enables the prize pools to accrue yield.
Gamification: Badges and leaderboards keep the experience fun and competitive.
Transparency: Every transaction and rule is on-chain and verifiable.
Low Fees: Base provides speed with minimal transaction costs.

Our Vision
Project Rebuild begins with one book, but that is only the start.
We imagine a world where ebooks succeed solely on merit, free from gatekeepers and Amazon algorithms that drown out indie voices.
In that world, creators (unknown or established) rise because their work connects with people, not because they game a platform, have the connections, or purchase enough ads.
Fans are paid for the word-of-mouth marketing they have always provided for free, while any hustler can jump in and earn after spotting a gem worth spreading.

Our goal is a self-sustaining model that benefits everyone.
Artists receive their fair share, fans & affiliates develop real income, and communities build direct bonds — turning one underdog's recovery into a decentralized revolution for all creators.
All without hype, driven only by aligned incentives.

messages.text:
Page Title: Our Mission
Sub-title: Creating a community-led platform where creators and fans can succeed together — beginning with my rebuild.

Our Purpose
Project Rebuild isn't merely an ebook launch — it's a movement focused on repairing what is broken in publishing.
After a seed-phrase wipeout cost me millions, I created a FAMM (Fully Autonomous Marketing Model) that enables creators to sell directly while paying fans instant, unlimited commissions + prizes for sharing their work.
Our mission is to build a fair, transparent ecosystem that rewards creators and fans for their contributions, referrals, and participation — without gatekeepers or artificial hype.

Community First

We trust in what a community can accomplish. Each member's success contributes to collective growth, transforming personal wins into momentum shared by everyone.

Fair Rewards
Unlimited, transparent, on-chain rewards make sure everyone receives what they deserve. There are no hidden terms and no middlemen.

Innovation
We're extending the boundaries of NFT, smart contracts, and decentralized technology. We will start by proving our FAMM, with the goal of becoming a full DAO after momentum builds.

Long-Term Vision
We're creating something sustainable that delivers real impact. This is a long-term effort to produce lasting value, scaling from one underdog story into a platform for everyone.

What We're Building
Referral Rewards: Receive $5 for every person you successfully refer to the project. Expand the network and increase your rewards.
Prize Pools: Small Block (5 × $500 every 500 sales) and Big Block (5 × $10,000 every 50,000 sales) use Chainlink VRF randomness to give referrers a fair opportunity to secure big wins.
Gamification: Badges, leaderboards, and achievement make the experience engaging and enjoyable while recognizing and rewarding active community members.
Transparency: All activity takes place on-chain. Smart contracts provide fair play and automated payouts.

Join the Movement
Become part of a community where your contributions are valued and your success is rewarded.
